app.name: Mintlify
app.description:
> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Do not install the Mintlify GitHub App through GitHub - you must do it through [the dashboard](https://dashboard.mintlify.com) in order for the connection point from your Mintlify account to your GitHub account to be made.


A GitHub app that allows you to:

- Sync your GitHub repository with your docs.
- Share previews of your docs with instant preview links.
- Receive CI checks for syntax errors in your PRs.
- Enable non-technical members of the team to contribute to the docs through our web editor.

Try now on https://dashboard.mintlify.com
